Usage: sink deploy new [OPTIONS] SERVER

  Upload a new version of the site.

  Upload a new version to the deploy root.

Options:
  -r, --real
  -q, --quiet      No itemized output from rsync.
  -d, --dump-db    Take a snapshot of the db.
  -n, --note TEXT  Add a note to DEPLOY_INFO.yaml.
  -h, --help       Show this message and exit.
